title: Hezekiah Cleanses the Temple

questions.question: How old was Hezekiah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:1 (ESV): "Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old..."

questions.question: What was the first thing Hezekiah did in the first month?
options: Opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them
questions.correctAnswer: Opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:3 (ESV): "In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them."

questions.question: Who did Hezekiah bring in to cleanse the temple?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:4 (ESV): "He brought in the priests and the Levites..."

questions.question: What was the result of their fathers' unfaithfulness?
options: Wrath of the LORD, sword, captivity, and plunder
questions.correctAnswer: Wrath of the LORD, sword, captivity, and plunder
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:8-9 (ESV): "Therefore the wrath of the LORD came... For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword..."

questions.question: How long did it take to cleanse the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:17 (ESV): "...and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished."

questions.question: What was found in the temple that they removed?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:16 (ESV): "...and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple specifically..."

questions.question: What sacrifice did they offer for the kingdom, the sanctuary, and Judah?
options: Seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats
questions.correctAnswer: Seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:21 (ESV): "And they brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering..."

questions.question: What instruments were used during the worship?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:25 (ESV): "He stationed the Levites... with cymbals, harps, and lyres..."

questions.question: When did the song of the LORD begin?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:27 (ESV): "And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also..."

questions.question: Who commanded the instruments?
options: David, Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet
questions.correctAnswer: David, Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:25 (ESV): "...according to the commandment of David and of Gad the king's seer and of Nathan the prophet..."

questions.question: Why did the Levites help the priests with the flaying?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:34 (ESV): "But the priests were too few... so their brothers the Levites helped them..."

questions.question: Who were more upright in heart to consecrate themselves?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:34 (ESV): "...for the Levites were more upright in heart than the priests in consecrating themselves."

questions.question: Who was Hezekiah's mother?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:1 (ESV): "...His mother's name was Abijah the daughter of Zechariah."

questions.question: How did the service of the house of the LORD end up?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 29:35 (ESV): "...So the service of the house of the LORD was restored."

key_verse_text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, in order that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
